description: Born in Reno in 1960, Ira has grown up here and attended local Washoe County schools. He met his wife, Alexis (Lloyd), at Sparks High School. Ira and Alexis have now been married for 38 years and currently have eight children and 17 grandchildren with one more on the way. State Senator Ira Hansen
